L01.speaker: narrator
L01.text: Every industrial site changes by the hour.

L02.speaker: narrator
L02.text: Contractors arrive. Equipment is isolated. Work moves.

L03.speaker: narrator
L03.text: Insurance sets conditions under which risk is accepted.

L04.speaker: narrator
L04.text: Good teams translate them into permits, briefings and checklists.

L05.speaker: narrator
L05.text: But no one can hold a moving site in mind.

L06.speaker: narrator
L06.text: On Roof 03, hot work begins, every safeguard in place.

L07.speaker: narrator
L07.text: Then a sprinkler zone goes offline.

L08.speaker: narrator
L08.text: Nothing looks different. The conditions have changed, and nobody sees it.

L09.speaker: narrator
L09.text: If something goes wrong, questions begin afterwards:

L10.speaker: narrator
L10.text: What was happening? Which condition applied? Can you prove what was true?

L11.speaker: narrator
L11.text: Today, the gap is often discovered too late.

L12.speaker: narrator
L12.text: What if the decision existed when the risk changed?

L13.speaker: worker
L13.text: I'm welding on Roof 03 until six.

L14a.speaker: narrator
L14a.text: Priora connects the work to the conditions that matter.

L14b.speaker: narrator
L14b.text: It checks the certificate and safeguards, and keeps the record.

L15.speaker: narrator
L15.text: Prevention before the work. Proof as it happens.

L16.speaker: narrator
L16.text: The sprinkler goes offline again. This time, Priora sees it at once.

L17a.speaker: narrator
L17a.text: The risk owner decides: change the work,

L17c.speaker: narrator
L17c.text: or, in time, ask selected carriers whether they will cover it.

L18.speaker: narrator
L18.text: Most work remains ordinary. A few changes become explicit decisions.

L20.speaker: narrator
L20.text: Priora. Infrastructure for activity-level physical risk.
